build_order: close the ruled values on the live Dashboard (replace the await-ruling note)
Pulse Strip transplant onto Personal, Business, Space
attribution capture at write time (joins, clicks, sales)
gate checks into the executable design gate
per-door lead blocks per placement matrix
Reports letters from Insight Feed; PI filled-vs-proven as a living graph

event_spine.attribution_rule: every conversion records its origin (join <- invite, click <- link+world, sale <- product+creator); until captured, insights stay honest aggregates
event_spine.provenance_line: every stats surface states: Ledger synced · N of M sources live
event_spine.tick_rule: all motion is driven by real ledger events; decorative motion fails the gate

gate_checks: obsidian computed background + white text; no white background anywhere
spectrum walk: no adjacent color repeat; WHAT categories in locked colors
honesty: unwired metrics render honest frames; no SAMPLE outside labeled specimens
SN-0822: every number carries magnitude + shape + direction + human sentence
family: every block byte-identical to the Factory part; sibling list attached
no dead chrome: no SOON pills; dark axes labeled with why or not rendered
motion truth: every animated element is driven by an existing ledger event kind
evidence: screenshot + measurements attached, or no ship

matrix.color_rule: each WHAT category owns one spectrum color network-wide; no adjacent repeat in any pill row
matrix.resting_state: everything — no Everything button, no Mix view; axes only narrow

leads: Health Gauge (filled vs proven as living graph)

placement.rule: blocks grow by import, never by invention

status: build-ready; base spec ULTIMATE-SMART-STATS (2026-10-22) remains the block/instrument canon

guards: no-harm: harm earns 0; continuous harm drives points negative and functionality fades toward none (Law of One)
cross-account farming detection takes the involved accounts down together

levels.display_rule: never a bare distance; always points-to-go plus pace-translated days (pace = trailing 7-day mean of earned points/day), e.g. '725 to go — about 21 days at your pace'
levels.open: stars six through nine unnamed — Shawn's to name

rows.guard: first invite per person only, sent through the system; not farmable

rows.note: stepping onto the stage, not paying; one-time so the leaderboard cannot be bought monthly
crown of the table; hardest signal to fake. Delta vs SN-1905 as filed (50 -> 100); canon amendment note owed

value_table.source_of_truth: this table only — Dashboard score, Smart Ledger, and SN-1905 canon all read from here
value_table.unwired_rule: unwired rows count 0 AND the surface states they are not tracked yet; a fabricated value fails the gate
